shape: 2-portal diagonal arena (N + S gates) with south clique and west pocket
description: Two-portal stage with a south clique (okby9v + uy3zyc + h6upjx + 4x7lkk) anchoring the south gate, a north clique (dgsn9n + bd6n20 + 52ssis) anchoring the north gate, and a single mid-bridge (h1s4qq) connecting east_mid to north_center. A west pocket (kmtm9a) hangs off the west-mid anchor as a dead-end.

portals.south: spawn_south at (11.84, 24.29) — gate on the south (high-Z) side, east column
portals.north: spawn_north at (-17.00, -23.53) — gate on the north (low-Z) side, west column

anchors.description: south entry hub - 4-way south-clique anchor (matches okby9v)
east-mid step - south to mid bridge (matches 4x7lkk)
mid bridge - east_mid to north_center (matches h1s4qq)

traversalNotes: Direct N→S: spawn_north → north_inner → north_c → mid_bridge → east_mid → south_inner → spawn_south. 6 hops via the mid bridge.
Alt route via west: spawn_north → north_inner → west_mid → north_c → mid_bridge → east_mid → south_inner → spawn_south (one extra hop, west arc).
mid_bridge (h1s4qq) is the only mid-arena connection between the south and north clusters — strict single bridge.
west_pocket and south_w are single-degree dead-ends — corner objectives.
south_inner is the 4-way south-clique dispatcher; north_inner is the 3-way north dispatcher.
